title: Tasty Kitchen A-Z
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: bright 3D tasty-kitchen storybook, fresh food colors, friendly cookware, clean high-contrast composition

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: picture-game learner with a supervising grown-up implied
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 names foods and object jobs from pictures. Hot, sharp or powered equipment is described, never operated by the child.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 is picture recall only and object-conditioned: foods show shape, peel, grid, ring, strands, or portions; bowls/cups/jars/trays make container shapes; spoons/ladles/forks/tongs/whisks show empty-hand silhouettes; drawers open in the air; timers trace a dial; cookie cutters trace an outline. Hot, sharp, or powered tools remain point-only or empty-hand mime while a grown-up handles the real item.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a glockenspiel shape-ping followed by one muted woodblock answer.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a glockenspiel shape-ping followed by one muted woodblock answer
